title: Cover First, Disagree Softly: Rethinking Mismatch-First Active Learning for Frame-Level Audio Classification
abstract: arXiv:2607.13571v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sound event detection relies on frame-level strong labels whose annotation is expensive. Active learning addresses this problem by selecting the audio segments whose labels help the classifier most. One of the prevailing acquisition strategies for this task, mismatch-first farthest-traversal (MFFT), combines the disagreement between two classifiers and the diversity of the selected segments through hard sequential decisions. It selects whole groups of high-disagreement segments first and spreads only the remaining budget by farthest traversal. On two multi-label datasets we show that this design is blind to the similarity among the selected segments and fails under low budgets, with every mismatch-first variant ending below the plain geometric strategy it builds on. We propose mismatch-weighted facility location (MW-FL), which spends the entire budget through a disagreement-weighted coverage objective that penalizes similarity

translated_title: 先覆盖，柔和分歧：重新思考帧级音频分类中的不匹配优先主动学习
translated_abstract: 声音事件检测依赖于帧级强标签，而这类标注成本高昂。主动学习通过选择其标签对分类器帮助最大的音频片段来应对这一问题。该任务中一种主流的获取策略——不匹配优先最远遍历（MFFT），通过硬性的顺序决策将两个分类器之间的分歧与所选片段的多样性相结合：它先成组地选择高分歧片段，然后仅将剩余预算通过最远遍历进行分配。在两个多标签数据集上，我们证明这种设计对所选片段之间的相似性视而不见，且在低预算下表现失效，所有不匹配优先的变体最终都低于其构建所基于的简单几何策略。我们提出了不匹配加权设施选址（MW-FL），它通过一个惩罚相似性的、以分歧加权的覆盖目标来利用全部预算。
tldr: 提出不匹配加权设施选址（MW-FL），以分歧加权的覆盖目标一次性利用全部标注预算，克服了MFFT忽视片段间相似性且在低预算下失效的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes mismatch-weighted facility location (MW-FL), which spends the entire budget through a disagreement-weighted coverage objective that penalizes similarity, overcoming MFFT's blindness to segment similarity and its failure under low budgets.
